findings.text: the assertion requires 'still has a live process' from the in-motion door, which the section requires to say 'liveness unknown' and never 'live process', so the landed change turns this test red (logs/neighbouring-doors-head.log: 1 failed, 17 passed, against 18 passed at base); the file is outside this node's write paths, so the one-line repair must land in a follow-up node before the merged head is green.

_repair_round_opened re-implements the capability the repository already owns at reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:871 (_opened_repair_rounds, re-exported by reckon/crew/recovery.py:169), which the module could import as it already imports other names from reckon.crew.recovery; the duplicate also drops the owner's fresh pointer read.

_attempt_stream_age falls back to the run's newest stream when the named attempt's own stream cannot be identified, and the message then calls that age 'its newest stream record', attributing another attempt's age to the attempt it names; the section requires a detail the records do not hold to be left out rather than guessed.

the head arm's log header names revision 5bc89fc029 (the base) while its own tree line and module.__file__ name the delivered worktree at c91556d0, so the record a later reader reconciles against the manifest's after_suite.revision (c91556d0) disagrees on the one field that says which revision was measured.
